description: Creates or overwrites a file with the full content. Prefer edit_file for changes to existing files. Pass base (the version read_file gave) when overwriting a file you read, or null for a file that must not exist yet: if the file changed meanwhile, the write is refused with file_changed, so read it again and redo the change.

base.description: The file's version from read_file, or null for a new file that must not exist yet. Optional

name: write_file
title: Write file
